items.title: Effectiveness of descent data whose total space is a disjoint union of spectra of Artinian rings
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces-simplicial.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Descent lemma (statement 6933-6939, proof 6941-6971): reduces effectiveness for a disjoint union of Artinian spectra to finitely many affine pieces - the partition via the equivalence relation on closed points has finite classes (cited lemmas), phi preserves the open-and-closed decomposition so the datum splits as a coproduct, and each piece is affine with effective descent data by the fpqc affine lemma; no verification is omitted. H2: descent bookkeeping reducing to the affine case.
